payload.text: The one-arm re-run that closes 0.1.26's helpers leg before the cut (vc's ask, made the bounce's first step by hv's 08:16Z fold order) holds until vc's word after hv's /compact. It runs helpers.bats's traps_restore arm (line 2558, 0311) alone, in pc0126's tree at f18a7a7c, by bin/devbin test bats --filter. It runs in the foreground with no nohup, under the bsd phase's gate environment, with the launching shell's trap -p HUP printed first. It books a light Desk slot naming exactly that, and END carries the arm's TAP line. Green: vc books the cut. Red with HUP at the default: a code red, and the cut stops.
